description: PSQ-2 v3: Class-balanced training on ALL step lengths 1-8. In-distribution gate test. v2 showed 73% on OOD 4-8 step; v3 asks whether the model can learn modular state tracking with explicit supervision at all lengths.
scientific_question: Can a 1.7B model learn modular state tracking across 1-8 step sequences with balanced in-distribution training? If yes: run d_4 measurement.
v2_lesson: v2 (73.4% OOD) shows composition from short training alone is insufficient. Explicit supervision at all lengths needed.
